// NEGATIVE fixture — `randomUUID` only where a lexer must not see it.
import crypto from 'crypto';

// A line comment: crypto.randomUUID()
/* A block comment: crypto.randomUUID() */
const SINGLE = 'crypto.randomUUID()';
const DOUBLE = "crypto.randomUUID()";
const TEMPLATE = `random bytes in hex, never crypto.randomUUID()`;
const IN_REGEX = /randomUUID/;

export function mentionsRandomUuid(source) {
  return /randomUUID/.test(source);
}

export function newId() {
  return crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
